senses.zh_definition: 可核实的外部参照是女性名字 Dinah；输入中的小写 dinah 是否指该人名，仍无法确定。
senses.en_definition: Dinah, a feminine given name; its identification with the supplied lowercase token remains unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Dinah ialah nama khas perempuan; belum dapat dipastikan bahawa bentuk dinah dalam input merujuk kepada nama tersebut.
senses.nuances: 本条仅提供明确标注的人名参照，不声称存在已核实的马来语普通名词 dinah。人名应大写，发音以本人采用的形式为准。下列组合是人名用法示例，不是已验证的高频词汇搭配。人名依据：[Reform Judaism：Dinah](https://reformjudaism.org/baby-names/dinah)。

etymology.historical_story: Dinah is independently documented as a feminine personal name with a Hebrew biblical background. That history belongs to the name, not automatically to every lowercase occurrence of dinah. Without the original Malay sentence, the packet cannot establish whether it contains this name, another proper name, a transcription error, or a separate lexical item. [Name reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/dinah).
